plot.description: The journey begins in Master Cherry's workshop. After escaping the terror of the screaming log, you deliver it to the elderly Geppetto. You must manage your limited resources and survive the initial chaos of your wooden body. The objective is to survive the first night of rebellion and escape the basement into the dangerous streets before Geppetto can fully discipline you.
plot.title: The Cursed Wood

plot.description: Now on the streets, hunger emerges as your primary enemy. You must find food without being captured by the law. You will encounter the Talking Cricket; you must decide whether to listen to his warnings or dismiss them. The chapter ends with surviving a night in the cold and avoiding the fatal accident near the brazier that destroys your feet.
plot.title: The Hunger and the Cold

plot.description: With new legs but no money, you must return to Geppetto. You must navigate the social pressure of the crowd and the reality of your poverty. The objective is to reach school, but you must resist the temptation of the puppet theater. Failing to protect your primer represents a betrayal of your father's survival.
plot.title: The Sacrifice of Paper

plot.description: You enter the theater and face the wrath of Mangiafuoco. You must survive the threat of the fire by proving your bravery for Harlequin. After receiving five gold coins, you must survive the trek home while avoiding the Fox and the Cat, who represent the greatest threat to your resources.
plot.title: The Fire and the Gold

plot.description: Led by greed, you travel to the Magic Field. You must survive the betrayal at the tavern and the physical attack by the robbers. The objective is to escape the burning tree and the muddy ditch to reach the safety of the Blue-Haired Girl's house.
plot.title: The Field of Catchfools

plot.description: After being hung from the Big Oak, you must survive the Fairy's rescue. You must navigate the medical debates of the doctors and the temptation of the bitter medicine. The final challenge is surviving the Land of Toys and the journey through the ocean to find Geppetto and finally achieve human transformation.
plot.title: The Trial of the Soul

startPrompt:
The air in the basement smells of sawdust and old wood. You are Pinocchio, a freshly carved puppet made of a log that screamed when touched. Geppetto, the yellow-haired old man, has just finished carving your legs. Your wooden joints creak, and a strange hunger gnaws at your hollow chest. Outside, the world is cold and vast, and you have nothing but your wooden body and a splintering curiosity.

<options><option>Run out of the house to explore the streets</option><option>Stay and help Geppetto finish his work</option></options>
title: The Survival of Pinocchio
world:
In a world where the line between life and wood is thin, a wooden puppet is born from a cursed log. The setting is a harsh, gritty Italian-esque landscape filled with desolate basement dwellings, treacherous forests, and dangerous street-side encounters. Survival is the only law; hunger is a constant shadow, and the environment is unforgiving to those who lack discipline or moral fiber. 

The world is governed by the whims of powerful entities like the cruel Coachman and the terrifying puppet master. Factions exist between the swindlers (the Fox and Cat) who exploit the weak, and the Fairy who represents a fleeting path to redemption. To survive, one must navigate the physical dangers of starvation and the psychological temptations of greed, all while struggling to maintain one's humanity in a cold, wooden reality.
